Maximizing gives b*=2v (capped at 49). With v=15, b*=30. This captures profitable cases where one opponent is below you and one above, while avoiding overpaying when both opponents are above you. I will bid $30.0 (valid at $0.1 increments).]

In a 3-player auction where the winner pays the lowest bid, bidding very high secures winning while the price equals the minimum of the other two bids. Expected min of two U[0,49] draws ≈ 16.33, so winning yields positive expected surplus (36 − ~16.33 ≈ 19.7). I will thus place a sufficiently large bid to win almost surely. ]
